summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of AMZ Prints ERP (mock mode). Verified new Orders card/table layout with Print / WhatsApp / Generate-Invoice / Edit / View buttons, new Payments module (transactions, stat cards, create-transaction dialog, category + method filters), and Settings loads cleanly. Found and fixed ONE critical import bug that caused a total white-screen crash before any UI could render.

ui_bugs.issue: PAGEERROR: 'mockPaymentsAPI is not defined' — new realPaymentsAPI wrapper was added and paymentsAPI export referenced mockPaymentsAPI, but mockPaymentsAPI was NOT added to the destructured import from './mockAuth'. This crashed the whole SPA at bundle-eval time → blank white screen for every route (including /login). FIXED by testing agent: added mockPaymentsAPI to the import list.

action_items: None blocking. Consider adding a lint rule / CI check for 'used-but-not-imported' identifiers so this class of module-import bug can't reach main again — same failure pattern as iteration_1 (Reports.jsx hooks import).

Nice-to-have: Settings page currently exposes tabs {Company, Invoice, Theme, Modules, Users, System}. Payment-methods config lives under 'Modules' → confirmed it opens without crashing but was not deeply exercised in this run because the primary regression check (module keys stable) is a code-level concern and no runtime error was seen.
critical_code_review_comments: api.js top-level import must be kept in sync with every new *API wrapper added below. A missing import here breaks the ENTIRE app (not just the affected module) because api.js is imported eagerly by the router.

OrdersList.jsx renderCard uses window.open(...) for both print and WhatsApp; browsers on desktop may block the popup silently. The code does not detect a null return from window.open — consider adding `if (!win) { toast.error(...); return; }` before writing to win.document.
Payments.jsx uses `fetch` as a local variable name that shadows the global fetch API. Rename to `loadPayments` or `refresh` to avoid confusion.
mockPayments dataset is defined with `let` outside the API object at module scope; that's fine for mock mode, but any HMR reload will reset the transaction list. Not user-facing but worth noting.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/services/api.js (added missing mockPaymentsAPI to the import from './mockAuth')
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test payment (party='TEST_Party_XYZ', 1234 Rs, Invoice Payment / Cash / Money In) — persists only in mock in-memory store for this session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App runs in MOCK mode. Login: admin/admin123. Orders page correctly renders 2 in-progress cards (ORD-001 Printing, ORD-002 Designing) and empty 'Completed & Cancelled (0)' table. Buttons on each card: view-order-*, invoice-order-*, whatsapp-order-*, print-order-*, edit-order-*. Generate-Invoice redirects to /invoices/:id and creates a new invoice in mockInvoices. WhatsApp popup opens wa.me (redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send) — expected. Print opens 'about:blank' popup then writes the HTML template — Playwright can catch the popup via context.on('page'). Payments page has full CRUD + category/method filters + 4 stat cards. Regression check on api.js import list is now clean.
rca_of_the_issue: During the Payments module addition, /app/frontend/src/services/api.js was extended with `const realPaymentsAPI = { ... }` and `export const paymentsAPI = createAPIWrapper(realPaymentsAPI, mockPaymentsAPI);`, but the top-level `import { ... mockReportsAPI } from './mockAuth'` was NOT updated to include mockPaymentsAPI. Because ES-module imports are evaluated eagerly, the module threw 'mockPaymentsAPI is not defined' before ANY React tree could mount, resulting in a blank white viewport for every URL. Reproduction: open any route (e.g. /login) → console shows PAGEERROR: mockPaymentsAPI is not defined, screen stays blank. Mitigation applied: added `mockPaymentsAPI` to the destructured import in /app/frontend/src/services/api.js. Post-fix re-run: login → dashboard → /orders (2 cards) → print popup → whatsapp popup (wa.me) → invoice-generate redirect to /invoices/inv_… → /payments (3 seed rows, stats correct, create-transaction persists, category filter shows 1 row for Expense Payment, method filter shows 2 rows for Bank Transfer) → /settings loads. Zero console errors across the full run.
